note: The site header AND footer contract shared by the marketing site and the Control Plane theme: which links, in which order, and where each one goes. Labels are NOT repeated here: they are brand/i18n/strings.json -> <locale>.header (nav.*, signIn, getStarted) and <locale>.footer (productHeading, trustHeading, links.*), generated from the site dictionaries. Both surfaces' tests compare their rendered header and footer with this file and those blocks, so the two cannot drift apart again.
localePrefix: English has no prefix. he, es and ru put /<locale> in front of every path below (the account area too: /he/my-account/).

fallback.product: A surface that does not sit behind the production edge (a QA or local Control Plane) has no /product/ page; there the Product link may point at the home page's #why section instead of a 404. The production host never uses the fallback.

footer.note: Two link columns (the third column of each footer is the language menu). A column's heading is footer[heading]; a link's label is footer.links[id]. The Control Plane's footer may add a non-link support line after the last trust link.
